fusions.name: Silverlings
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers of water in a fan, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Undercurrent
fusions.desc: Hurls a stinger of water that deals 14 damage and knocks the target back 3 tiles. It then darts to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Shoal Cover
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and raises your dodge chance by 10%.

fusions.name: Closing Ranks
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, you gain a ward that soaks 25% of your maximum health for 8 seconds, and a shoal of stingers fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
